method: 60s actual patrol/CCTV at60Hz; tile centres and authored safe-route points sampled2Hz with collision+LOS. Eight axes retained separately, including per-route escape exposure with initially open doors (patrol diagnostic, not theft/lockdown simulation); potential coverage is not guaranteed detection. High outliers use per-chapter Tukey fence, never auto-tuning. No human difficulty certification.
